sources.kind: archive directory (HTTP range read of ZIP central directory)

sources.location: https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13225231 (Malyutina et al., Dis Model Mech 2026, PMID 41782446, doi 10.1242/dmm.052681)

claims.value: 190 RAW files: EH2641-EH2709 subset (60, cerebellum), EH1902-EH1971 (70, cortex), EH2920-EH2980 subset (60, hippocampus)
claims.evidence: RAW files are only deposited inside three ZIP archives; names read from ZIP central directories by range request. Each claimed once. File names are the inner names, not the archive names.
PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; mouse UniProt FASTA in mqpar; paper Methods.
Region taken from the archive each file sits in (LC-MS_files_CB/cortex/HC); paper abbreviations CB, CTX, HC.

Numeric/CTX experiment names from mqpar <experiments> mapped to raw files. Six cortex RAW files (EH1933-36, EH1938-39) are absent from mqpar and get a run-based name. Own labels; no genotype or age key is deposited.
Paper describes WT and Cstb-/- mice at P14, 1, 3, 6 months, but no deposited file or table maps individual RAW files/experiments to genotype or age. Not inferred.
PRIDE instrument and protocol text 'QExactive HF'. RAW header not read.
Protocol: all analyses in data-dependent acquisition mode.
Protocol: 'high-energy collision-induced dissociation' on a Q Exactive HF (HCD).
Digest with trypsin; MaxQuant search used Trypsin/P ('without proline restriction').

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (C) fixed; Oxidation (M) and Acetyl (Protein N-term) variable
claims.evidence: Identical in all three mqpar.xml files and the data processing protocol.
mainSearchTol 4.5 ppm in mqpar (protocol text says 6 ppm; mqpar preferred).
MaxQuant FTMS MS/MS match tolerance 20 ppm.
